verdict.rationale: AFK is an ops-automation product, so a visual workflow builder is a fair axis. The evidence describes AI decomposing goals into a directed graph of steps that it executes, plus no-typing form pre-fill. None of it documents a visual editor where an ops user builds or arranges multi-step workflows themselves, so this is adjacent behavior rather than the capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code
